Package com.pulumi.cloud.sdk

Class ApiClientConfiguration

  • java.lang.Object
    • com.pulumi.cloud.sdk.ApiClientConfiguration
  • public class ApiClientConfiguration
extends java.lang.Object
    Connection settings shared by every generated *Api class.

    host is the API origin (no /api suffix — the generated resource paths already start with /api/...). accessToken supplies the Pulumi access token sent as Authorization: token <token>; it is a Supplier so a rotating token can be re-read per request. Return null for unauthenticated requests.
